input.summary:
Part 6 "chimneys, walks and grounds" now builds with no REFUSED and no OFF-PALETTE lines; make.sh exits 0 and writes build.nbt (1115 placed, 6991 cells).
The fix is in parts/grounds.mjs only: the five reserved hearths (P0 W and E, P1 N, P2, P3) drop chimney writes at y1..3 in their wall line, because the shell already holds those cells as air. The other chimneys are unchanged.
Those five hearths have no lintel or wall masonry at y2..3, so the mouth is a 3-high opening into the flue. That needs a fix in Part 1 (shell); fit still flags nine chimney-fire faults.
left: Hearths P0 W (2,y,17), P0 E (13,y,17), P1 N (27,y,21), P2 (35,y,17) and P3 (51,y,17): the shell (Part 1) leaves the wall cells at y1..3 as air, so the lintel (brick_stairs y2) and the masonry at y3 are never built. The hearth mouth is therefore a 3-high opening into the flue. Fix belongs upstream: Part 1 must leave those mouth cells for chimney() to fill (not air), then grounds drops the reserved flag and the drop-filter in chimneyAt goes away.

`mcd fit build.nbt --rooms rooms.json` reports 9 chimney-fire faults, outside this part's writes: flue open on two sides above the firebox at (1,1,17), (14,1,17), (27,1,22), (34,1,17), (50,1,17); the roof's brick_slab walls the flue at y15..16 on all eight stacks (including 78,1,17 P4, which is otherwise clean). The roof and shell parts own these; I did not change them.
fit also reports 5 'hallway to nowhere' issues; I did not examine them since they sit in room and shell parts, outside this part's scope.

waste.what: Finding the full list of refused cells: runParts caps the refusedAt report at 8 entries (tools/src/build.mjs, `refused.slice(0, 8)`), so the 15 refusals showed only 8. I copied tools/src to /tmp, removed the cap there, and reran a debug build to get all 15.
waste.cost: about 6 tool calls and one copied library tree
waste.tool: runParts report with all refused cells (or `--refused all`, or refusedAt written to parts-report.json in full), so a part author sees every locked cell at once

waste.what: Working out which cells chimney() writes into the shell's locked air by reading chimney.mjs hearthPlan cell by cell (mouth, lintel, flue walls at y1..3 of the wall line).
waste.cost: one source read plus manual coordinate tracing across five chimneys
waste.tool: chimney() option that skips locked or already-occupied cells (e.g. `skipLocked: true`) or a hearth report listing which of its cells would be refused before the part runs

waste.what: Writing a per-chimney write filter (chimneyAt) around chimneyStack, because chimneyStack writes straight through g and cannot be told which cells are locked.
waste.cost: three edits and one make run to confirm the REFUSED line cleared
waste.tool: chimneyStack option or runParts `ownedBy` predicate exposed to parts, so a part can ask 'is this cell mine to write?' instead of guessing from the shell's plan

companions.task: Lay the lintel and wall masonry over the five reserved hearth mouths once Part 1 leaves those cells for the chimney (P0 W and E, P1 N, P2, P3).
Check the flue walls at y15..16 where the roof slab meets the stack on all eight chimneys, and confirm the stack runs solid through the roof.
Fix the roof's brick_slab edge at the stack so it stops against the chimney masonry rather than walling the flue at y15..16.
